fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami-area civic conditions and development, including calls to clean up the Miami River and concerns about sanitation and riverfront shacks; discussion of housing vacancies and rent levels ahead of the winter tourist season; promotion and critique of business practices such as transient seasonal merchants; and reporting and opinion on oil/natural gas drilling prospects near Miami. Also includes coverage of prohibition-era crime and law enforcement matters (including the arrest of “Pop” Nesle), transportation/traffic incidents, and community entertainment and sports notices (golf, boxing, dances), with letters to the editor reflecting public sentiment after the hurricane and about policing.
